name: regimens
description: Regimens inventory system — monorepo scripts for local and deploy.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix database
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend
scripts.deploy:prepare: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix database
